names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 13 noiembrie, «Sfânta Antuza, mama Sfântului Ierarh Ioan Gură de Aur».

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (25 September 2026).

feast.note: The page the calendar links carries no Viață tab and no Tropar tab, so the line is the whole source. The same calendar keeps an unidentified «Sfânta Cuvioasă Antuza» on 12 aprilie, of whom it says nothing at all; this folder is only for the woman the 13 noiembrie line names as the mother of John Chrysostom.
